What Is Kids Room Design?

Kids room design shapes one room around the many ways a child lives in it: sleeping, playing, studying, dreaming and growing. The layout needs to feel fun and comfortable while staying safe and easy to use.

We plan age-appropriate furniture, storage, lighting and flexible details that can move from nursery to toddler room, school-age bedroom and teen space without starting over each time.

NurseryToddlerSchool ageTeen

What We Deliver

Eight practical layers create a room that is safer, calmer and easier for a child to enjoy every day.

Scroll through the complete kids room scope.

01

Layout & Space Planning

Clear zones for sleep, play, study and storage, with comfortable movement between them.

02

Age-Appropriate Design

A room shaped for nursery, toddler, school-age or teen routines.

03

Play Area Integration

Open floor play, child-height toy storage and a creative corner within easy reach.

04

Storage & Organization

Accessible places for toys, books, clothes and school supplies that help children tidy up.

05

Safety-First Design

Rounded edges, anchored furniture, non-toxic materials and cordless blinds.

06

Study Nook

A desk, task light, comfortable chair and focused setup for schoolwork.

07

Grow-With-Child Design

A neutral base, changeable accents and convertible furniture that adapt over time.

08

Durable & Easy-Clean Materials

Washable paint, stain-resistant fabrics and tough flooring for active family life.

Our Design Process

Five clear stages take the room from family needs to a complete, build-ready design.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We learn the child’s age, needs and interests, involving them when appropriate.

02

Site Measurement

We record room dimensions, openings, built-ins and safety considerations.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Sleep, play, study, storage and circulation come together in one plan.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

We coordinate safe, durable furniture, finishes, lighting and colours.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

You receive drawings, specifications, safety notes and clear 3D views.

Consultation to final design packageTypically 1–2 weeks from consultation to final design package.

Kids Room Design FAQs

Straight answers on cost, safety, shared rooms and designing for change.

The initial consultation is free. Design consultation starts from around PKR 10,000, while full packages range from PKR 15,000–35,000 depending on size and complexity.

Use a neutral, lasting base and changeable accents. Flexible furniture can then adapt as your child gets older.

Anchor tall furniture, use rounded edges, choose non-toxic paint and install cordless blinds. We build these choices into the room plan.

A nursery centres on a crib, changing area and calm light. A toddler room introduces a low bed, more floor play and storage the child can reach.

Yes. We give each child a clear sleeping and storage zone, then plan shared study or play space around the room’s size.

A typical kids room takes 1–2 weeks from consultation to the final design package.
